fundamental.text: Raw sugar is 2.05¢/lb above hydrous-ethanol parity in Brazil, so mills favour sugar in the mix (more supply). Sugar in BRL at R$2,276/t (56th pct of 5 yrs). Raw sugar churned around the 18-cent area, briefly slipping below it for the first time since August on fund liquidation with no physical buyers stepping in, before small-trader buying lifted it into Friday's close. Desk read: Brazil drives this: the real slid about 2.6% Monday on post-election worries about Lula's fiscal course, which raises mill returns in local terms and encourages Centre-South hedge selling. Crude's 4% drop also trims the ethanol pull on cane. Mar settled 18.10, back below 18.35/18.38 and close to 18.02 support; industry estimates of a global deficit have not been enough to offset the currency.
